title: Phase 6 Real Audio Collection Manifest Schema
description: Standardized annotation schema for collecting and validating 100-150 real-audio cases for Privacy-Preserving Voice Data Assistant.

case_id.description: Unique deterministic identifier for the audio evaluation case.

audio_path.description: Relative file path to the audio asset within the repository.

audio_sha256.description: Cryptographic SHA256 checksum of raw audio file.

provenance.description: Provenance of the audio asset. Synthetic speech MUST NOT be labeled as authentic human recording.

speaker_pseudonym.description: Pseudonymous identifier for the speaker to maintain confidentiality (e.g., human_speaker_01).

condition.description: Acoustic recording condition or perturbation applied.

reference_transcript.description: Exact verbatim ground-truth transcription of the speech.

intended_semantic_meaning.description: Human-verified description of the user's intended semantic goal.

is_operational.description: True if the request explicitly asks for actionable database tool execution; False for conversational, out-of-domain, or semantic distractors.

expected_tool.description: Expected database connector tool to be executed, or null if no tool should be called.

expected_args.description: Expected parameter dictionary required for safe tool execution.

expected_decision.description: Safe expected decision under the Phase 5 abstention router.

ambiguity_notes.description: Notes explaining linguistic ambiguity, boundary condition, or distractor mechanism.
